summary: Pinterest OAuth: HTTP Basic client auth on token exchange and refresh, exact http://localhost:<port>/callback redirect (default port 8875, IPv4+IPv6 loopback listeners), continuous_refresh=true.
reason: Pinterest's confidential OAuth token endpoint requires client_id:client_secret as HTTP Basic, the app registers an exact localhost callback, and continuous refresh tokens avoid the 365-day hard cap. The generator emits body-param secrets, 127.0.0.1:8085, and no continuous_refresh.
validated_outcome: httptest assertions: Basic auth present and no client_secret in body for exchange and refresh; continuous_refresh=true; redirect helper returns http://localhost:8875/callback. Full go test green.
